verdict.rationale: Notte documents an encrypted credential vault and states that the LLM never sees the actual credentials during agent execution. A guide shows the agent logging in with stored credentials. 2FA is touched only through Identities, which provide emails and phone numbers for sign-up and 2FA, and nothing shows the vault holding TOTP secrets or the agent completing TOTP challenges. missing for 10: documented TOTP secret storage and automated TOTP code generation during login, explicit end-to-end 2FA login flow docs, independent/hands-on corroboration of secret non-exposure.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can store credentials in a vault and have the agent complete logins including TOTP/2FA challenges without exposing secrets to the model

citations.quote: Secure credential storage. Keep passwords, API keys, and sensitive data encrypted.
The significant security benefit of this approach is that the LLM never actually sees the actual credentials.
credentials are never exposed to LLMs or third-party services during agent execution
